channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Supreme Court rules against private prison firm facing forced-work suit from immigration detainees in Colorado
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday ruled against a private prison company facing a lawsuit alleging immigration detainees were forced to work and paid only $1 a day in Colorado.

item.title: Thornton grass fire is contained following temporary closure of I-25, evacuations of school and businesses
item.description: Firefighters will remain in Thornton throughout the night to monitor the remnants of a fast-moving grass fire that tangled traffic.

item.title: Opinion: As energy bills climb, Colorado needs smart policies to accelerate the affordable clean energy build-out
item.description: Fair, transparent decisions will maximize benefits for Colorado communities, protect land and support wildlife

item.title: With no end in sight to dry days and high wildfire risk, Colorado eyes a task force
item.description: Warmest start to a water year in 131 years leaves experts hoping for a spring miracle, but a coalition of agencies focused on water, agriculture and emergency management is forming

item.title: Greeley voters reject project that would have built a new arena for the Colorado Eagles
item.description: A voter-backed measure will repeal the zoning permit for a proposed city-owned, $1 billion entertainment district in West Greeley.

item.title: What’s plug-in solar? Colorado legislators promote a bill to help eager consumers find out.
item.description: Millions of the portable, “balcony” size systems are being installed around the world. Should the state catch up?

item.title: Trump strips endangered species protections for lesser prairie-chicken, the dancing, booming grouse of the Southwest
item.description: The bird has been a target of farming and oil and gas interests for years, while environmental groups have pushed for more protections

item.title: Lauren Boebert disrupts Epstein deposition by sharing photo of Hillary Clinton
item.description: Closed-door deposition was paused after Colorado representative broke committee rules and sent photo to conservative influencer

item.title: Denver mayor orders police to protect city residents from ICE
item.description: Mayor Mike Johnston’s order requires local law enforcement to intervene when federal agents use potentially deadly force in the city

item.title: Vacancy committee selects former state Rep. Adrienne Benavidez to replace Sen. Dafna Michaelson Jenet
item.description: Benavidez resigned from the legislature in 2022 after losing the race for House Speaker
